test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech of the sentence:

She said, "Why didn't anyone inform me about the change?"

options.text: She asked why had no one informed her about the change.
She said why was no one informing her.
She asked why no one had informed her about the change.
She asked why didn't anyone inform her about the change.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Indirect speech is used to report what someone has said without quoting their exact words.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Change in tense:** In indirect speech, past perfect tense is used to replace the past tense when the reporting verb is in the past. Here, "didn't inform" becomes "had informed."
 
• **Change in pronouns:** The first-person pronoun "me" changes to "her" to match the subject of the reporting clause (She).
 
• **Question to statement:** The sentence is converted into a statement form. "Why didn't anyone inform me" becomes "why no one had informed her."
 
 
 
• **Correct Sentence:** She asked why no one had informed her about the change.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** She asked why had no one informed her about the change.
 
 
• Incorrect word order. In indirect speech, the auxiliary verb "had" should follow "no one," not precede it.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** She said why was no one informing her.
 
 
• Incorrect tense. "Was informing" is present continuous, which does not match the reported past event.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** She asked why didn’t anyone inform her about the change.
 
 
• Incorrect tense and structure. The question is not properly converted to a statement form, and "didn't" should not be used in indirect speech.
